subject: SKU consolidation & amortized listing fee schedule (AWS/GCP/Azure)
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@awsmarketplace.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SKU consolidation & amortized listing fee schedule (AWS/GCP/Azure)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Per our conversation, I've attached a draft fee schedule that amortizes the one-time listing fees across multiple SKUs over a 12-month period instead of billing them as upfront charges. The goal is to make Redwood's cash flow smoother for customers while keeping marketplace economics neutral.

High-level summary: 
- Applies to newly consolidated SKUs (see tab "SKU_map")
- Default amortization term: 12 months (flexible by agreement)
- AWS proposes monthly settlement credits against listing charges (invoice-level reconciliation)

Questions for you: 
1) Would Redwood prefer amortized credits applied as monthly invoice line-items or a single monthly reconciliation credit?
2) Are you planning to consolidate all current marketplace SKUs, or only newly onboarded ones?

I've also looped in Vanessa from partner ops to validate the SKU mapping. Attachment: AWS_fee_schedule_v2.xlsx

Happy to hop on a call if you'd rather walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,
Maya Singh
Partner Programs 
AWS Marketplace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@awsmarketplace.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SKU consolidation & amortized listing fee schedule (AWS/GCP/Azure)

Maya —

Thanks for the draft. A few quick asks from our side so we can move this through procurement and legal: 

- Please include a worked example showing the monthly invoice entry and the net P&L timing impact (we need to see both the invoice credit flow and the accounting treatment)
- Can you confirm whether the amortization credit will be visible on the marketplace invoice as a separate line (preferred) or as a negative adjustment to the gross listing fee?
- We're planning to consolidate the legacy SKU set and a small batch of new SKUs (see "SKU_map" tab requested). Vanessa, can you eyeball the mapping and call out any gaps?

Also, please loop in your GCP counterpart — we want a consistent approach across clouds. Adding a HubSpot reference here so procurement can tie changes to the renewal: HS-948273.

If you can get the sample invoice and a cross-cloud note from GCP by EOD Friday, procurement will circulate internally for accounting sign-off. Happy to do a 30-min sync if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Quick updates: 
- AWS can show amortized credits as a separate monthly line on the invoice OR as a consolidated credit (both are technically feasible). We recommend separate lines for transparency.
- I've attached a short note from GCP on their amortization mechanics and a blank SKU mapping template. GCP typically amortizes at the partner-account level and issues a monthly reconciliation file.
- Marketplace Procurement (cc) can support an inter-cloud settlement note if you want AWS to take the lead on consolidated invoicing.

Attachments: GCP_listing_amortization.pdf

Thanks everyone — quick recap and proposal from Redwood: 

- Term: propose a 9-month amortization (compromise between cashflow and accounting simplicity)
- Invoice presentation: separate monthly credit line per marketplace (preferred for transparency)
- Reconciliation cadence: monthly; AWS to provide invoice-level credits, GCP to provide monthly reconciliation file; Partner Procurement will manage any inter-cloud settlement notes
- Next steps: Vanessa will upload the SKU mapping CSV to the shared drive (redwood_SKU_mapping.csv), Aditya will run the P&L sensitivity model, and Lauren will review contract language for a short amendment.

I'm good to confirm the 9-month term pending Aditya's numbers. Can we schedule the 30-min working session for Wed 10:00 AM PT? I'll send a calendar invite once the time is confirmed. HubSpot deal HS-948273 will be updated with the amendment doc.

Thanks,
